title: Driving Theory Test 2026 Kit
description:
We have been voted No. 1 driving theory test app*! Includes all the latest official revision questions and answers for 2026, including Hazard Perception Clips. All materials are licensed by the DVSA (Driver and Vehicle Standards Agency).

ΓÇö 98% of our active users pass their theory test the first time ΓÇö

This app is suitable for ALL learners in both Great Britain and Northern Ireland and contains 6 apps in 1:

- Car Theory Test
- Motorcycle Theory Test
- LGV Theory Test
- PCV Theory Test
- ADI Theory Test
- Hazard Perception Test

What makes our app so good:

** DVSA revision questions ***

Practise revision questions licensed to us by the Driver and Vehicle Standards Agency (people who set the test)

** Syncs across all your devices ***

When you create an account, you can sync, save and track your progress across all your devices.

** Works offline ***

Practise for the driving licence test anywhere, anytime.

** Answer Explanation ***

Each practice question contains the explanation of the answer from the DVSA, increasing the effectiveness of your driving theory test preparation.

** Case Studies ***

Just like those you'll encounter during your actual test.

Note: currently case studies are available for car and motorcycle databases.

** Mock test ***

Take unlimited mock tests which are just like the actual DVSA exam.

** Voice Over ***

In case you have a reading difficulty, or if you don't feel like reading yourself, our app can now read EVERY question to you! This feature can be turned ON in the Settings.

** Flagged questions ***

Flag the toughest questions on a well-designed user interface to review them again later (for example, 30 minutes before the exam).

** Personal Trainer ***

Your "own Sherlock Holmes" thoughtfully detects the questions you need to learn the most and presents them first. Practising for the driving theory test has never been easier!

** The Highway Code ***

Driving Theory Test 4 in 1 Kit contains a link to our standalone Highway Code app. It is free and includes all the latest revision tools licensed by DVSA.

*** Northern Ireland ***

Tailored for learners across the UK, including Northern Ireland. With support for both GB and NI formats, you can study with confidence and pass with ease. Just select your region in Settings ΓÇö it takes just a moment.

** Compatible with your Apple Watch ***

We are proud to be one of only two theory test revision providers who offer a standalone Apple Watch app! You can now study for your test anytime, anywhere.

** Super flexible ***

Driving Theory Test 4 in 1 Kit comes with powerful and easy-to-use settings which make practising for the licence exam easy for everyone.
